One musical task
Create an eight-count tap/rest pattern. Repeat it twice while a partner follows the pulse.
WHO IT SERVES
Adult beginners. No instrument or music-reading experience required.
PRACTICE BEFORE PERFORMANCE
Follow a slow counted example, vary two positions, then try your own sequence.
A VISIBLE CHECK
Partner checks the eight positions and whether the repeat stays in the same order.
